The weighted port throughput calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk-assessment logic.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across all trials with zero exceptions recorded. The pytest suite in 'test_output.py' passed successfully in 0.287 seconds using version 8.4.1. While the verifier reward was 1.0, the judge reward of 0.66 suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling despite functional correctness.
